extDescription.message: Proposes a second draft of what you just typed, using Chrome's built-in on-device AI. Nothing leaves the machine.

cmdOpenPicker.message: Draft an alternative for the focused field

statusNeedsDownload.message: The model isn't on this machine yet. Open the toolbar icon to download it.

statusFirstModel.message: Downloading the model, this happens once…

statusFirstPack.message: Downloading the translation pack, this happens once…

statusInsertedNoUndo.message: Inserted. This field doesn't support undo, so Cmd+Z won't bring back your original.

panelHint.message: Runs on-device. Nothing leaves this machine. Cmd+Z undoes the insert.

errTooLong.message: That's too long for the on-device model. Select a smaller chunk.

errUnavailable.message: Built-in AI isn't available here. Open the toolbar icon to check what's missing.

errNoInsert.message: Couldn't write into that field. Copy it instead.

errFieldChanged.message: The field changed while the draft was being written, so nothing was inserted. Copy the draft instead.

errClipboard.message: The page blocked the clipboard. The text is selected — press Cmd/Ctrl+C.

errUnknownLanguage.message: Couldn't tell which language that is.

errAlreadyEnglish.message: That text already looks like English.

errNoPack.message: Chrome has no $LANG$ to English translation pack available.

errEnglishOnly.message: Only applies to English. This looks like $LANG$.

errEnglishOnlyHint.message: That preset only applies to English, and this looks like $LANG$. Try Translate to English.

popupReadyDetail.message: Rewrites run locally. No text leaves this machine.

popupDownloadingDetail.message: Chrome is fetching the model. You can close this popup.

popupDownloadableDetail.message: Chrome can run the model on this machine, but has to fetch it first. It is a few gigabytes and only happens once.

popupUnavailableDetail.message: This Chrome build or this hardware can't run the on-device model. It needs Chrome 138+ on desktop, roughly 22 GB free disk and a supported GPU.

optSub.message: Presets you add here appear next to the built-in ones, in the panel and in the right-click menu. A label plus an instruction to the model.

optEmpty.message: No rewrites of your own yet.

optSaveFailed.message: Could not save — Chrome refused to store this. Try shorter instructions or fewer presets.

optInstructionPlaceholder.message: Instruction to the model, e.g. "Rewrite this in plain, direct language. No superlatives, no exclamation marks. Return only the rewritten text."

optEnglishOnly.message: Only offer this for English text

welcomeSub.message: It rewrites what you typed, on your machine, and never replaces it without asking.

welcomeStep1.message: Click into any text field on any site and type something.

welcomeStep2.message: Press the keyboard shortcut, or right-click the field and choose Second Draft.

welcomeStep3.message: Pick a rewrite, edit it if you want, then press Insert. Cmd/Ctrl+Z brings back your original.

welcomeNote.message: The first run downloads Chrome's on-device model, which is a few gigabytes and takes a while. Click the toolbar icon to start it and watch the progress. Nothing you type is ever sent anywhere.
